title: Obsidian Monolith Slab
description: Ultra-compact sintered stone with deep black continuous veining. Engineered to withstand extreme environmental conditions, this surface is entirely non-porous and scratch-resistant. Delivers an uncompromising, bold aesthetic for luxury spaces.

title: Calacatta Gold Vein
description: Luxurious white porcelain with warm gold and gray veining, perfectly bookmatched. Advanced digital glazing ensures a luminous, high-depth finish that mimics natural Calacatta marble flawlessly. Ideal for premium master bathrooms.

title: Emerald Onyx Luxe
description: Deep green backlit-capable translucent ceramic mimicking rare natural onyx. This vivid, polished slab utilizes crystal-frit technology to achieve unparalleled optical depth. An absolute showstopper for hospitality feature walls.

title: Industrial Corten Steel
description: Porcelain slab engineered to replicate oxidized weathering steel. It captures the raw, urban patina of rusted metal without any of the structural degradation or staining risks. Perfect for striking commercial facades.

title: Nordic Ash Timber
description: Ceramic wood plank with extreme hyper-realism and zero-maintenance durability. Featuring a synchronous 3D grain texture, it provides the warmth of Scandinavian ash while remaining impervious to moisture.

title: Travertine Navona
description: Warm beige architectural stone-look tile with linear directional veining. This surface offers the timeless elegance of Roman travertine, enhanced by modern stain resistance. A staple for sophisticated, minimalist architecture.

title: Midnight Terrazzo
description: Modern dark terrazzo with oversized marble chips in white and amber. It combines traditional Venetian craftsmanship aesthetics with cutting-edge porcelain resilience. An excellent choice for high-traffic commercial zones.

title: Aegean Blue Glaze
description: Artisan-crafted ceramic tile with a reactive blue glaze finish. Each piece exhibits slight tonal variations, mimicking the depths of the Mediterranean sea. Ideal for bringing vibrant color to wet rooms and backsplashes.

title: Brera Concrete Light
description: Minimalist architectural concrete-look porcelain for seamless open spaces. It features subtle trowel marks and a muted, industrial palette without the cracking and sealing issues of poured concrete.

title: Verde Alpi Marble
description: Striking dark green marble-look slab with brilliant white quartz veins. Manufactured using 8K digital printing to ensure zero pixelation. Brings profound luxury to bespoke kitchen islands and executive spaces.

title: Statuario Extra
description: Classic white Italian marble look with subtle, elegant grey veining. A timeless aesthetic upgraded with a diamond-polished glaze that reflects natural light beautifully. Ideal for brightening up classic interiors.

title: Urban Cement Grey
description: Raw concrete aesthetic perfect for loft and industrial interior designs. This tile provides an ultra-flat, rectified edge for minimal grout lines, creating a monolithic floor surface.

title: Sahara Noir Dark
description: Black porcelain featuring striking, razor-sharp golden and white veins. The intense high-gloss finish enhances the contrast, creating a dramatic architectural statement for lounges and boutique lobbies.

title: Ivory Limestone
description: Soft beige stone-look tile offering a warm, inviting residential atmosphere. Its gently honed surface provides excellent slip resistance while remaining soft to the touch.

title: Oxford Charcoal
description: Deep grey, nearly black porcelain with a smooth monolithic appearance. Fired at over 1200 degrees, this dense material is virtually impervious to stains, fading, and moisture.

title: Venetian Terrazzo White
description: Classic white terrazzo look with multicolored glass and marble fragments. Engineered to be lighter and stronger than poured terrazzo, allowing for faster installation in high-end spaces.

title: Pietra Grey Velvet
description: Warm grey Iranian stone look with delicate white sedimentary lines. The velvet matte finish absorbs light, creating a calming, serene environment for luxury spa interiors.

title: Cortina Alpine White
description: Pristine white architectural tile with ultra-low water absorption. This bright, unblemished surface acts as a blank canvas, maximizing spatial perception in smaller modern rooms.

title: Rustic Oxidized Iron
description: Metallic-look porcelain that captures the essence of weathered industrial iron. Featuring a unique semi-polished 'lappato' finish that catches the light on its raised textures.

title: Carrara Classic
description: The timeless Italian Carrara marble reproduced in durable porcelain. Each tile features varied graphic faces to prevent visible pattern repetition, ensuring a completely natural look.

title: Basaltina Black
description: Volcanic basalt stone replica with a textured, slip-resistant surface. The deep charcoal coloration and micro-pitted texture hide dirt and footprints exceptionally well.

title: Onyx Pearl
description: Luminous pearl-colored onyx look with deep visual depth and high gloss. The multi-layered digital glazing process creates a three-dimensional illusion of translucent stone.

title: French Oak Chevron
description: Pre-cut chevron porcelain planks mimicking aged French oak. This ready-to-lay format saves tremendous labor time while delivering the classic Parisian apartment aesthetic.

title: Oceanic Blue Slate
description: Rich blue-grey slate replica with natural clefting texture. The varied surface topography provides excellent grip and a highly organic, earthy feel for wet zones.

title: Arabescato Corchia
description: Dramatic heavy-veined Italian marble design for bold architectural statements. The stark contrast between the icy white background and deep charcoal veins creates instant visual impact.

title: Titanium Travertine Slab
description: Massive continuous slab featuring silver and titanium travertine cross-cut layers. Manufactured using advanced compaction technology, it offers the beauty of large stone without the fragility.

title: Nero Marquina Infinite
description: Deep black slab pierced by lightning-white quartz veins, suitable for bookmatching. This sintered surface resists heat, etching, and scratching far better than natural marble.

title: Calacatta Macchia Vecchia
description: Stunning white slab with thick golden and caramel brecciated veins. The silk finish provides a soft, organic touch while maintaining zero porosity for statement kitchen islands.

title: Industrial Zinc Slab
description: Architectural slab replicating patinated industrial zinc sheets. At only 6mm thick, this lightweight material is perfect for cladding massive interior walls and elevator lobbies.

title: Invisible White Sintered
description: Almost pure white slab with faint, ghostly grey spiderweb veining. Engineered for ultimate purity, it will not yellow over time under UV exposure.

title: Emperador Dark Slab
description: Rich brown Spanish marble look with intricate crystalline webbing. The high-gloss polish accentuates the deep chocolate tones, creating a sense of warmth and luxury.

title: Pulpis Grey Mega-Slab
description: Warm grey monolithic surface with subtle tonal variations and light veining. The soft matte finish reduces glare, creating a sophisticated and grounding visual base.

title: Statuario Supremo
description: The highest grade of faux-Statuario, featuring pure white background and bold strikes. This 20mm thick variant is designed for robust countertop applications requiring edge profiling.

title: Amazonite Blue Slab
description: Exotic turquoise and teal quartz-look slab with intense golden fractures. Lightweight and highly flexible, this 6mm slab can be applied over existing surfaces for rapid luxury renovations.

title: Raw Concrete Monolith
description: Ultra-large format concrete-look slab with authentic pitting and trowel marks. It provides the heavy, brutalist aesthetic of poured concrete without the complex structural requirements.

title: White Macaubas Quartzite
description: Linear-veined Brazilian quartzite replica for sleek, modern countertops. Sintered at extreme temperatures, it is completely immune to hot pans, acidic spills, and red wine stains.

title: Portoro Gold Black
description: Luxurious black Italian marble-look slab dripping with gold chain veins. The large format sizing allows for sweeping, uninterrupted patterns across grand entrance halls.

title: Sodalite Blue Mega
description: Deep cobalt blue lapis-lazuli inspired ceramic slab for dramatic interiors. Featuring sweeping white and silver nebulas, it functions as a piece of architectural art.

title: Breccia Capraia
description: White background slab featuring striking purple and burgundy brecciated veins. The hyper-detailed digital print captures the chaotic, natural fragmentation of authentic breccia stone.

title: Fior di Bosco Slab
description: Elegant taupe-grey marble look with delicate white and orange veining. The honed silk finish offers a buttery tactile experience that softens sharp architectural lines.

title: Aqua Marine Subway
description: Hand-crafted aesthetic ceramic subway tile in a glossy sea-glass blue. Its uneven surface gracefully catches and reflects bathroom lighting, giving walls a rippling water effect.

title: Carrara Hexagon Mosaic
description: Classic Carrara marble-look porcelain mesh-mounted hexagon mosaic. The multitude of grout lines provides exceptional slip resistance, making it perfectly code-compliant for wet floors.

title: Matte Black Penny Round
description: Contemporary matte black penny round mosaic for striking bathroom floors. This flexible mesh-backed sheet easily molds around curves and shower drains.

title: Emerald Zellige
description: Moroccan-inspired square zellige tile with high tonal variation. Each tile features an irregular, undulating surface and a rich, glassy glaze that bounces light beautifully.

title: Terrazzo Flake Vanity
description: Soft pink and white terrazzo porcelain tile designed for bright vanity walls. Highly resistant to cosmetics, hard water, and bathroom cleaning agents.

title: Calacatta Gold Chevron Mosaic
description: Elegant chevron pattern mosaic in white and gold marble-look porcelain. Ready-mounted on mesh sheets for rapid installation, this geometric pattern draws the eye upward.

title: Charcoal Fluted Panel
description: 3D fluted ceramic wall tile adding architectural shadow play to bathrooms. The deep vertical grooves elongate the perception of wall height in confined spaces.

title: Spa Bamboo Ceramic
description: Textured ceramic tile mimicking raw bamboo strips for Zen spa aesthetics. Provides the organic tranquility of natural fibers without rotting or warping in steam-heavy environments.

title: Arctic White Large Format
description: Pure, seamless white porcelain to create minimal grout lines in modern showers. The expansive format makes small bathrooms feel larger and reduces cleaning maintenance.

title: Stone River Pebble Mosaic
description: Porcelain-cast pebble mosaic providing natural acupressure for shower floors. These rounded faux-stones offer incredible grip and water drainage channels.

title: Bluestone 2CM Paver
description: Heavy-duty 20mm thick porcelain paver mimicking natural thermal bluestone. Rated to withstand immense load-bearing weights and severe freeze-thaw cycles without cracking.

title: Travertine Crosscut Exterior
description: Frost-resistant outdoor paver with the elegant look of unfilled travertine. Unlike real travertine, this porcelain will not absorb pool chemicals, salt, or patio stains.

title: Urban Anthracite 20mm
description: Dark grey concrete-look paver designed for modern pedestal systems. Allows for easy installation over waterproofing membranes on elevated rooftop terraces.

title: Teak Wood Decking Paver
description: Faux-wood porcelain paver that never splinters, fades, or requires sealing. Features a deeply grooved R11 anti-slip surface ideal for wet outdoor zones.

title: Quartzite White Paver
description: Sparkling white stone-look paver that reflects heat around pool areas. Ensures barefoot comfort even in peak summer temperatures while providing exceptional grip.

title: Basalt Black Cobble
description: Small-format thick porcelain scored to look like traditional European cobblestones. Engineered to withstand heavy vehicular torque on residential driveways.

title: Limestone Sand Paver
description: Warm sandy limestone replica, perfect for Mediterranean-style landscaping. Resistant to moss, mold, and efflorescence, making it ideal for shaded garden pathways.

title: Corten Steel Decking
description: Industrial oxidized steel-look pavers engineered to withstand severe freezes. Won't leach rust onto surrounding surfaces like genuine Corten steel.

title: Alpine Slate Paver
description: Deep clefted slate-look paver in dark green and charcoal tones. Mimics the organic fracturing of natural mountain slate with none of the flaking or chipping.

title: Terrazzo Al Fresco
description: Exterior-rated terrazzo-look paver with high slip resistance for outdoor dining. Unaffected by BBQ grease, wine spills, or acidic bird droppings.

title: 3D Ribbed Pearl Panel
description: Large format ceramic wall panel with a deeply ribbed 3D profile. The architectural ridges create an impressive interplay of light and shadow.

title: Oxidized Copper Facade
description: Lightweight ceramic panel designed for ventilated exterior building facades. Mimics the vibrant turquoise patina of aged copper roofs.

title: Split Face Slate Panel
description: Faux split-face ledger stone panel for fireplaces and accent walls. The interlocking Z-shape design hides seams completely for a flawless, dry-stacked stone appearance.

title: Geometric Gold Deco
description: Ceramic wall tile with real 24k gold geometric inlay patterns. Fired multiple times to ensure the precious metal bonds permanently to the ceramic body.

title: Emerald Fluted Glass-Look
description: High-gloss ceramic panel that mimics the look of architectural fluted glass. The vibrant emerald pigment sits beneath a thick layer of glass-like glaze, providing immense visual depth.

title: Travertine Flute Panel
description: Stone-look fluted panel adding verticality and texture to grand lobbies. The precision-milled grooves create rhythmic shadows that shift throughout the day.

title: Black Basalt Hex Clad
description: Large interlocking hexagon panels for bold, modern architectural cladding. The dense, matte black surface absorbs light, providing a striking backdrop for modern fixtures.

title: Acoustic Wood-Look Slats
description: Ceramic wall panel designed to mimic trendy wooden acoustic slat walls without fire risk. Completely incombustible, making it ideal for commercial corridors and elevator lobbies.

title: Japanese Charred Cedar
description: Porcelain plank inspired by Shou Sugi Ban (Yakisugi) burnt wood technique. Features a deeply textured, crackled surface with profound charcoal tones.

title: Scandinavian White Pine
description: Ultra-light wood-look ceramic for airy, minimalist Nordic interiors. Bleached tones and subtle graining help maximize natural light in smaller spaces.

title: Reclaimed Barnwood
description: Highly varied rustic wood plank featuring faux nail holes and saw marks. High-definition digital printing ensures over 60 unique plank faces to avoid visible pattern repetition.

title: Walnut Grand Parquet
description: Pre-assembled Versailles parquet pattern in deep, rich walnut porcelain. This majestic design allows for rapid installation of complex geometric wood floors.

title: Smoked Oak Plank
description: Elegant dark brown oak replica with subtle tonal shifting. The extra-long 150cm format mimics premium, wide-plank hardwood flooring beautifully.

title: Bleached Elm Chevron
description: Light, modern elm wood designed in a ready-to-install chevron format. Creates dynamic directional energy on floors without the immense carpentry costs of real chevron wood.

title: Mahogany Yacht Deck
description: Glossy, high-end mahogany wood-look tile with faux rubber gasket lines. Directly inspired by luxury nautical design and vintage Riva speedboats.
